contexts.text: The universe, which they believe to circumgyrate...
The sun of Heaven... does not produce these states by any circumgyration. AC 7381:4.

An evil Spirit cannot circumgyrate his body from left to right, but from right to left; but a good Spirit can with difficulty circumgyrate his body from right to left, but easily from left to right. The circumgyration follows the flux of the interiors which are of the mind.
I have been able to feel such circumgyrations... upon me...
They were punished by... circumgyration. Described.
